FYI from reviewer-inspector (task complete, so the agent was not woken): done: The inspector needs another round: the verdict is **fix**, with six fixes and five notes. The full review is in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-page-design/inspector/review.md`.

1. **No styling.** No CSS match

findings.text: Inspect ships no CSS: no rule anywhere matches `item-inspector-*`, `delta-history-*` or `live-settings-inspect`. So each row's class name runs straight into its title ("settings — SettingsLivePage", "h0xklxtePageHeading" in proof/plan-settings-1200.png), the rows sit on bare background while Files above them sit in white cards, and "WHAT IT IS MADE OF" stacks directly on "INSIDE" as two identical h4s. Add an `Inspect.css` (or `live-settings-*` rules) that frames the rows like `LivePage.Files` and separates the type.

The DeltaHistory summary shows only list counts ("content: 11"), but requirements.md deliverable 2 asks for "title, cards in order, sub-pages". List each card (id and title) and each sub-page at line N, not just a number (`ext/Inspect/DeltaHistory.js:47-50`).

The proof doesn't show the slider. All four shots are the top screen only and end inside "Inside", so neither Methods, Fields nor the slider at line 1 and line N appears in any image. Deliverable 4 asks for that proof. Take full-page shots, or one at line 1 and one at line N (proof.md rows 3-6).
ext/Inspect isn't indexed. `public/framework/ext/readme.md` "## Index" lists every ext module, and Inspect has no line there. Deliverable 6 says "check", and law 10 requires the index line.

The method walk is now written twice (`ext/Inspect/ItemInspector.js:7-11` and `live/design/ui/MethodMap.js:37-42`), against law 6. The brief explicitly allowed moving the walk into Inspect and having MethodMap import it: ext may be imported from /live/, and the direction that is forbidden is core importing ext. The readme's reason for the copy ("MethodMap lives under /live/") argues for that move, not against it.

Heading cards show only their id ("h0xklxte", "wbswuioz") because `ItemInspector.js:51` reads `title`, and a part-heading keeps its words in `text`. Fall back to `text`, cut short, when there is no title.

"Inside" lists internal lists: `_pages (1)` (the virtual settings page itself) on /live/plan/ and `removed (15)` on /live/design/ (design-settings-1200.png). Consider skipping lists whose name starts with `_`, or labelling the removed ones as removed.

`DeltaHistory.js:35` creates `this.$list` but never fills it. The line rows are appended after `$summary` instead, so on a 141-line page the summary sits above a very long list that has no scroll limit. Put the rows in `$list` and give it a max height.

DeltaHistory replays as `Page` whenever line 1 names no type, even on a LivePage or DesignPage (`DeltaHistory.js:26`). Settings knows the real class (`of.constructor`) and could pass it in as `{Class}`.

The brief's "first comment line" for each method was optional ("if cheap") and was skipped. Also, Methods lists every method of the class, not only the ones a delta can call. That is fine for now, but worth one line in the readme's Watch out.

No `ext/Inspect/page.js` exists, so the readme's own url shows only the readme. Other ext modules have a page with a live example (ext/readme.md Index). A one-line demo would fit the "show the class" rule.

**Verdict:** fix. All six numbered asks in the brief are met.

**The fix:** in the Fields section, the name "description" breaks in the middle of the word: "descriptio / n" at 1200 and "descr / iption" at 400. The style that lets each row wrap anywhere also breaks the field name. Keeping the name on one line and letting only the value wrap would fix it.

**Notes:**
- **Files outside

findings.text: A field's name breaks in the middle of the word. In Fields, "description" shows as "descriptio / n" at 1200 and "descr / iption" at 400 (proof/plan-settings-1200-lineN.png and -400-line1.png, Fields band). The cause is `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on `.item-inspector-row`, with the key and value sharing one row. Fix: give the key `flex: none; white-space: nowrap` (or a fixed-width key column) and let only the value wrap.

The branch carries about 30 files it was not allowed to edit: the generated `files.jsonl` indexes and two `{"file":…,"gone":true}` lines in `public/live/page.jsonl`. They came from wip commit `f0099ade5` ("pick up other agents' appended lines"). They are generated, append-only lines, but commit by exact path was the rule. Check that the merge does not duplicate them in the logs.

Settings says "Lines 13", but the slider reaches "line 14 of 14" on the same page (proof/plan-settings-1200-lineN.png, top band vs the History band). `LivePage.Settings` counts `of.jsonl_lines`, while DeltaHistory counts `store.entries`. One of the two numbers is off by one, or the two count different things, and nothing tells the reader which.

At line N, "How it got here" repeats the "Inside" list row for row: the same 11 cards (proof/plan-settings-1200-lineN.png, rows 330–760 and 1290–1720). That roughly doubles the page. At N, a line such as "same as Inside (11 cards)" would say the same thing, and the list can come back for n < N.

Two headings sit directly on top of each other: "WHAT IT IS MADE OF" and then "INSIDE", with nothing between them (both proofs). The first finding of round 1 is not fully fixed. Drop ItemInspector's "Inside" heading when it sits under Settings' own heading, or make one of the two visibly lighter.

The ext/Inspect doc page has no visible demo when it opens. Its Overview is one link card on 84% empty space (shots/…-framework-ext-Inspect/1200.png; layout.json `empty 0.835` at 1200). DeltaHistory has no demo at all. Requirement 1 asked for "the ones a delta can call", but Methods lists all of them (Page has 107). The readme's Watch out notes this, so it is not hidden.
